dam.title: Cross-Platform Application Development
dam.subtitle: Higher Vocational Education
dam.phrase1: Development of cross-platform applications using Java, applying object-oriented programming, data structures, and design patterns.
dam.phrase2: Implementation of graphical user interfaces with JavaFX and web application development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including REST API consumption and integration.
dam.phrase3: Design, modeling, and management of relational and NoSQL databases using MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
dam.phrase4: Version control with Git and adoption of collaborative workflows.
dam.phrase5: Software solution analysis and design using UML, alongside the application of Clean Code principles, documentation best practices, and development methodologies for building maintainable and scalable applications.

smr.title: Microcomputer Systems and Networks
smr.subtitle: Intermediate Vocational Education
smr.phrase1: Configuration and administration of Linux and Windows servers, deploying and managing network services such as DHCP, DNS, HTTP, and FTP.
smr.phrase2: Design and management of network infrastructures and virtualized environments using VirtualBox.
smr.phrase3: Execution of hardware diagnostics, stress testing, and performance analysis using tools such as MemTest86, Cinebench, and 3DMark.
smr.phrase4: Network traffic monitoring and analysis with Wireshark, combined with cybersecurity implementation using firewalls, antivirus solutions, and vulnerability scanning tools like OpenVAS.
smr.phrase5: Administration of operating systems, server environments, development tools, and IT infrastructures.
